result.summary: The page renders mostly correctly, but there is one clearly broken element: a raw localization key is displayed instead of a translated section title. A few secondary inconsistencies were also noted in the restaurant cards and carousel.

issues.description: The section heading below 'Fastest near you' shows the raw i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable label such as 'Popular near you'.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing translation string for the 'home_feed.popular_title' key (and add a sensible fallback so raw keys are never rendered to users).

issues.description: The favorite (heart) buttons on the two popular restaurant cards use inconsistent styling — the first is a white circle with a dark outline heart, the second is a dark/translucent circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button treatment (same background, size, and icon color) across all restaurant cards.

issues.description: The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel ('Trattoria Piccol…') is cut off at the right edge with its title clipped and no visual affordance that the list scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal padding/peek width and text truncation with ellipsis, or a scroll indicator/arrow so users know the row is scrollable.

issues.description: The second popular restaurant card is clipped by the bottom navigation bar with no visible name, rating or metadata, making the feed appear cut off.
issues.suggestion: Ensure scroll content has bottom padding equal to the nav bar height so cards are never permanently obscured.

issues.description: Icon-only controls (notification bell with unread dot, heart favorite buttons, search magnifier) have no visible text labels; if accessible names are missing they will be unusable with screen readers.
issues.suggestion: Provide accessible labels (e.g. 'Notifications, 1 unread', 'Add to favorites') for all icon-only buttons.
